fields.label: Personal Identity Number
fields.description: Swedish personal identity number (personnummer), used as the tax identification number for individuals who are or have been registered as resident in Sweden

fields.label: Coordination Number
fields.description: Swedish coordination number (samordningsnummer), an identification number for individuals who are not and have not been registered as resident in Sweden and which may be used for taxation and other official purposes

fields.label: Corporate Identity Number
fields.description: Swedish corporate identity number (organisationsnummer), the unique identification number assigned to legal persons and other registered organizations

fields.label: VAT Number
fields.description: Swedish VAT identification number (momsregistreringsnummer/VAT-nummer) assigned to persons and organizations registered for VAT
